handoff: Review #1: approve. AC1-AC4 traced to release-record.test.ts; no blocking findings. Minor: F1 the branch commit comes from the local head, F2 a stale push_record after a GR6b close under remote, F3 no test for a rejected record at the tick close, F4 the lease is the local ref (gh-195/10). Unit, typecheck and touched integration files green.

findings.title: Norn-Branch-Commit comes from the local branch even when that branch was not pushed
findings.detail:
pushReleaseRecord takes the commit from refs/heads/<branch>. releaseStory pushes the story branch only when the story has a worktree (loc?.worktree). If the story has a branch but no worktree, the record can name a commit the remote lacks; act's pushRecord refuses exactly that case (act/lifecycle.ts:467, review F5). If the branch exists only on the remote, the record is written as 'no story branch' (B33) and the reply says so.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch> once the branches are pushed, as act does, or push the branch even when it has no worktree.

findings.title: A GR6b tick under remote can act push_record after close_story already pushed the record
findings.detail:
Under record.policy remote, storyLifecycle emits close_story and pushRecord(ctx, story, ref) still emits push_record for the same story. closeStory pushes the record. The push_record act then leases on the old expected sha, fails as stale, and the trace says 'another checkout pushed it ... owed to the next tick' (lifecycle.ts:474). Nothing is overwritten, but the trace line is misleading. act.cleaned only filters facts, not actions.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Do not emit push_record when the story emitted close_story this tick, or skip it in act once act.cleaned has the story.

findings.title: The GR6b tick close has no test for a rejected record push
findings.detail:
lifecycle.ts closeClosedIssueStory now reports record_push_failed. story-reopen AC2 covers only the success path (the record ref is kept). No test rejects the record during a tick close and checks that the claim is held and nothing is removed. The slice ACs name only story close, so this does not block.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a tick-close case with the pre-receive hook to release-record.test.ts.

findings.title: The record lease is the local ref, and observe with sync never does not fetch refs/norn/runs/*
findings.detail:
A checkout that never fetched the remote record leases on null, so every handoff or close would be refused as stale. The do_instead 'check the remote, then run ... again' cannot fix that. Acceptable only if gh-195/10 adds the fetch when it reads the record on the other machine.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Confirm in gh-195/10 that observe fetches refs/norn/runs/<story> before a release.

findings.title: Dead branch r.sha === null
findings.detail:
Only the 'empty' result carries a null sha, and the line before already returns for it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop the conditional.

findings.title: Exit 3 (refused) also for a record push that failed on the network
findings.detail:
AC3 asks for exit 3 on a rejection. A network or transport failure gets the same code, while a failed branch push in the same command uses failure (error). The same applies to story-close.ts:86.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Keep refuse for rejected or stale pushes and use failure for transport errors, if the spec allows it.

findings.title: branchCommitOf hides git errors as null
findings.detail:
A failed git log reads as 'no trailer'. That is safe, because a mismatch only pushes again, but the error is never reported.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None needed; at most add a comment.
